workload.description: One configured check that spawns a process. 100 is a large real repository's contract (this one runs around forty); the ladder reaches 2,560 to expose how scheduling scales. It stops there, not at 10,240, because every check spawns a real process and larger sizes take minutes per sample.

contribution.description: This is the end-to-end operation itself.
Not part of the end-to-end operation, which measures the scheduler on its own (`run-checks`).

runRepoContract.config.env: fixed: `process.env`, passed by reference as the contract's own config does
runRepoContract.config.killProcessTree: not covered: only used on Windows to end a check's process tree after a timeout or an abort
runRepoContract.config.shell: fixed: `false`, the argv-only default every check here uses
runRepoContract.config.spawn: fixed: node's `child_process.spawn`, as the contract's own config passes it
runRepoContract.options.checks: fixed: every check selected, which is what a full contract run does; selecting fewer is the same work on fewer checks
runRepoContract.options.signal: not covered: an abort is a failure path; the steady-state cost is the successful run

notBenchmarked.commitlint: It only assembles one check definition from two short strings, a constant amount of work done once; the commit-message tool it runs is a process the contract itself spawns and times.
notBenchmarked.distNoUrls: It only assembles one check definition from two short options, a constant amount of work done once; the scan the check performs is a process the contract itself spawns and times.
notBenchmarked.onEvidenceSaveToRepoContractLogs: A thin wrapper that returns the `saveEvidence` hook of `repoContractLogs`, which `save-evidence-to-logs` in the policy-evidence suite benchmarks with every one of its options accounted for.
notBenchmarked.onVerdictPrependRepoContractLogs: A thin wrapper that returns the `prependVerdict` hook of `repoContractLogs`, which `prepend-verdict-to-logs` in the policy-evidence suite benchmarks with every one of its options accounted for.
